canonical_project: FINTEL Vatuwaqa Communications Centre (VCC) colocation environment
notes: FINTEL official pages (checked 2026-08-12) describe secure, resilient, scalable data-center colocation facilities at VCC for mission-critical IT/network infrastructure, plus cable landing station facilities, Satellite LEO Gateway/SNP hosting (power/cooling/backhaul) and telehousing. VCC is Fiji's international gateway and cable landing station operator (Southern Cross, Tonga Cable, ICN1, Tui-Samoa, Gondwana 2, Google Tabua/Bulikula). FijiIX is hosted at VCC (UNESCAP 2022 presentation). Classify as cable hub + colocation-adjacent telecom; no public MW/rack specs; not general commercial colocation beyond FINTEL's stated offerings.
